About AutoStacc

AutoStacc is where artists sell their sounds: sample packs, presets, stems, music and visuals, each credited to the project that made it.

How it works

  1. 01Artists make itMusic, samples, MIDI, presets, stems and visuals, under their own name and style.
  2. 02AutoStacc sells itEvery product is credited to the project that made it. Payments are handled by Stripe, so your card details never reach this site.
  3. 03You download itYour files are ready as soon as payment is confirmed, and stay in your account to download again.
  4. 04Free releases come to youFollow a project and turn on Auto-Stacc: its free releases are added automatically. Paid releases are shown as new, never added for you.

Key terms

Your Stacc
Your library: everything you've Stacc'd, from every project.
Stacclet
A collection of related Pacs from one project.
Pac
A folder of content: MIDI, samples, loops, presets and more. Download one file, a selection or the whole Pac.
Auto-Stacc
Adds a followed project's free releases to Your Stacc automatically.
